ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-28-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Dave Davenport.

Christopher Daley, Esq., and co-counsel Shannon Minter, Esq., for Timothy William Larkins. This matter continued from Oct. 23, 2003, with petitioner's appearance waived. The issue of change of the birth certificate for a person residing in California but born in another state, specifically New York, was ruled upon. The court has determined it has jurisdiction to grant to petition for change of gender as well as granting the name change.

The Court grants the petition for change of name to: RANDI ANGELI WRYTT

The Court further orders the GENDER of RANDI ANGELI WRYTT is changed from MALE to FEMALE.

Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-23-2003 Reset To Oct-28-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Leticia Perez.

Christopher Daley, Esq., for Petitioner Timothy Larkins, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The matter is continued Oct. 28, 2003 at 9:00 am in Dept 218. Appearance by Petitioner is waived.
